purpose: Isolated S31 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Substantial/persistent aggression synthesis uses source periods (scenario interval, lifetime treatment context, current_encounter synthesis) with clinician-reported fields; a PANSS hostility item score alone never maps the gate.

fields.definition: Schizophrenia status represented by the scenario; registration diagnosis review establishes Yes/No for this encounter.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Implementation (schizophrenia context); diagnosis v1 supplies structured diagnosis, this field is the reviewed encounter synthesis
fields.operationalization: Yes requires a documented current schizophrenia diagnosis review at this encounter; No requires a documented assessment finding schizophrenia not established. Unknown assessment pauses. Copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician synthesis of substantial aggression-related risk; informed by clinician-reported aggression fields over the scenario interval with lifetime context, never a PANSS hostility item score alone.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Implementation (risk remains substantial despite other treatments); Quality Measurement Considerations (structured diagnosis and risk-factor entry with rating-scale data); content/assessments/panss.v1.json hostility item is a non-equivalent input, never the gate
fields.operationalization: Yes requires clinician synthesis of substantial aggression-related risk from clinician-reported fields: scenario-interval aggression observations plus lifetime aggression and treatment context, recorded at the current encounter with encounter/window attribution. A PANSS hostility item score alone never maps Yes. No requires a completed structured assessment finding no substantial aggression risk. Missing synthesis pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record (scenario-interval observations and lifetime context where applicable); copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Persistence of aggression-related risk despite other treatments, with prior-treatment context and window; distinct from the two-trial treatment-resistance construct.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Implementation (risk remains substantial despite other treatments; attention to adherence)
fields.operationalization: Yes requires documented persistence of aggression-related risk despite other treatments with prior-treatment context (agents and changes, no regimen details) and scenario-interval window; distinct from two-trial resistance. No requires assessment finding risk did not persist despite treatment. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Clinician-determined urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs at this encounter; displayed independently of estimation latency.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Implementation; Balancing of Potential Benefits and Harms in Rating the Strength of the Guideline Statement / Harms
fields.operationalization: Present means clinician identifies an urgent safety concern from saved structured urgent inputs during current assessment; Absent means urgent assessment was completed without identified concern. This banner renders from saved inputs independently of estimation latency and is never a model-computed risk percentage. Unknown assessment pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: An adherence problem or uncertainty about treatment exposure represented in the scenario.
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician identifies an adherence problem or exposure uncertainty; No means adherence review found no identified concern. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Presence of modifiable aggression-risk factors that can serve as intervention targets in constructing a plan of treatment.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Implementation (modifiable risk factors as intervention targets)
fields.operationalization: Yes means clinician identifies at least one modifiable aggression-risk target for intervention planning; No means review found none. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Never, current or previous clozapine treatment represented in the scenario.
fields.operationalization: NeverTreated requires explicit assessment of no prior or current clozapine; CurrentTreatment/PreviouslyTreated require documented status with encounter/window. Unknown history pauses. No dose/route/frequency collected. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Willingness to discuss clozapine; patient-preference review input.
fields.operationalization: Yes means patient is willing to discuss clozapine after shared discussion; No means unwillingness or unresolved concerns documented. Missing discussion remains unknown, not No. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Availability of a clozapine monitoring and follow-up plan per current prescribing information.
fields.operationalization: Yes means a clozapine monitoring and follow-up plan is available per current prescribing information; No means no such plan available. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.

fields.definition: Completion status of a clozapine medical review for harms and suitability.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/guideline/STATEMENT-09.md — Balancing of Benefits and Harms; Harms
fields.operationalization: Yes means clozapine medical review for harms/suitability is completed; No means not completed. Unknown pauses. Page notes are never mapping input.
